Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms.

**Welcome to Generation CE

**You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions.

As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations

• translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes

• ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends

• overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives

• strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams

• promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience

• bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team

• understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry

• have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management

• can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions

• communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

JMP, a subsidiary of SAS, is committed to empowering scientists and engineers via our world-class family of statistical software products. For over 35 years, JMP has enabled customers to speed new drugs to market, to design better products and processes, and to figure out how to restore ecosystems. Advancements are made when brilliant people use JMP statistical discovery software to see what they’ve not seen before. If you are a problem solver, a connector, and someone who enjoys helping others, then you might just be the next person to join this dynamic, growing, and global team.

About the job

We are looking to hire an experienced New Business Salesperson to join our successful sales team, selling JMP software to both new and existing customers. To join this team the successful candidate will need to prove their record of consistently over-achieving sales targets while helping their customers to deliver long-term value from the use of their products.

You will be responsible for finding new business and managing existing accounts where you will have ownership of the full sales cycle through to close. You will be responsible for sales of JMP software products in a high volume, multi-tasking sales environment.

You will work with the JMP Sales Team to demonstrate and prove JMP’s customer value and drive new business across Ireland and Nordics.

As an Account Executive, you will:

• Create opportunities and customer alignment to JMP’s likely customer profile.

• Prospect within the assigned sales territory to uncover business needs.

• Help define and deliver the territory and account management plan; identify new target accounts with high "close" potential, qualify sales opportunities and accurately forecast your pipeline of qualified sales opportunities to deliver JMP software sales revenue.

• Work closely with the sales territory teams, including Inside Sales, Sales Engineer and JMP management in all aspects of the sales process.

• Prepare quotations and proposal information as needed; work with relevant JMP departments to create and finalize contracts.

• Engage with senior Decision-Makers in your existing customers to ensure ongoing satisfaction with their JMP products and to discover and develop additional revenue opportunities.

• Apply your knowledge of JMP’s marketing goals, JMP applications, supported hardware platforms, marketing and business trends, and industry knowledge to assess your customer’s potential needs.

• Ensure all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization's secure software development goals.

• Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.

Required qualifications

• Requires a minimum of 5 years of experience in a full sales cycle - with a successful and proven track-record - in the sales of computer software solutions or scientific and engineering hardware (including products and services related to JMP’s target markets). Specific experience related to JMP’s target markets may be considered in combination with the above requirements.

• Bachelor's degree, preferably in Business, Marketing, MIS, or other relevant discipline.

• This is primarily a new business role which would suit a focused and high activity salesperson. The new business revenue comes from new-name accounts and growing the use of JMP software for existing customers, where the sales opportunities need to be uncovered and developed.

• Ability to analyse and evaluate territory dynamics and develop a sales plan; ability to communicate technical and business concepts and relate them to JMP software and user needs; ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Knowledge of sales techniques; knowledge of software acquisitions cycles and buying influences.

• Ability to travel regularly and extensively within the territory and occasionally internationally.

• Hybrid work style.

• Proof of Right to work in the UK or Denmark with ability to travel across Europe. Fluency in Danish is preferred.

• Equivalent combination of related education, training and experience may be considered in place of the above qualifications.

Additional competencies, knowledge and skills

• Creating Demand Through Insight - Identifying the targeted account’s business challenges and needs and their probable causes; providing and provoking convincing insights that compel decision makers to discover or reconsider unrecognized problems and opportunities and the value of addressing them with new solutions to achieve better long-term results (e.g., profitability, revenue, market share).

• Advancing Sales Discussions - Leading discussions with influential decision makers that progress the sale by effectively clarifying information, offering insights, addressing objections, and gaining agreement to move to the next step in the buying process.

• Driving for Results - Setting high goals for personal and group accomplishment; using measurement methods to monitor progress toward goals; tenaciously working to meet or exceed goals while deriving satisfaction from that achievement and continuous improvement.

You are welcome here.

What if your curiosity could help build the world we all imagine?

Are you eager to impact modern society while growing your professional and personal skills in a welcoming environment? Launch your career with our Forensic & Integrity Services team at EY, starting August 2027. We’re committed to investing in your potential throughout your journey.

The opportunity: your next adventure awaits

As a Graduate in Forensic & Integrity Services, you’ll join our Assurance services, gaining experience alongside forensic professionals across different sectors. Our team spans accounting, law, finance, data analytics, technology and investigations, helping clients navigate sensitive challenges.

From the start, you’ll join project teams investigating complex matters across industries. Assignments may involve financial and accounting records, electronic data, interviews, policies, contracts, and transaction documentation.

Depending On The Assignments, You May Work On

• Reviewing financial records, transactions, contracts and documentation to identify patterns and relevant facts

• Assisting with whistleblower investigations and other sensitive fact-finding assignments

• Analyzing structured and unstructured data, including financial data and electronic communications

• Supporting compliance reviews and assessments of ethics, governance and internal control frameworks

• Contributing to interviews, evidence summaries, presentations and investigation reports

We offer varied work experience that helps you grow professionally in an inclusive culture. You’ll be surrounded by committed colleagues, we value spending time together, both at work and socially.

Through internal coaching and training, you’ll build the skills to stay relevant now and, in the future, while growing a network of colleagues, mentors and leaders at EY.

To learn more about our teams within Assurance, please visit our career page.

What We Look For

• 
Enjoys understanding how facts and financial information connect

• 
Approaches complex information in a structured and analytical way

• 
Pays attention to detail without losing sight of the broader issue

• 
Can communicate clearly and objectively, both in writing and in conversation

• 
Takes responsibility, asks questions and is motivated to learn

• 
Qualifications:

• 
You completed your studies in 2026 or are set to graduate in summer 2027 with a degree within economics, finance, law, data analytics and/or technology (e.g. cand.merc.(aud.), cand.merc.(jur.), cand.jur., cand.polit, data science or similar).

What’s In It For You

• Supportive onboarding with your own buddy and counselor.

• Flexible and hybrid working conditions.

• Highly collaborative teams and great support of a network of knowledgeable colleagues.

• Continuous development and opportunities to grow your career.

What You Can Expect

If this position interests you and you recognize yourself in the description, we would like to hear from you soon. Application deadline: 15 November 2026.

Recruitment Process

• Application: Fill out the application form and upload your CV, cover letter and a copy of your most recent grade transcript.

• Assessment: After submitting your application, you will receive a link to our assessment within a few days. It takes about 20 minutes and must be completed by 18 November.

• Video: Following the assessment, complete a brief video interview of three questions on your motivation, submitted by 22 November.

• Interview: Selected candidates will be invited to face-to-face interviews on an ongoing basis at the EY Office in Copenhagen.

As we review applications continuously, we recommend applying promptly, as the position may be filled before the deadline.

Please note that only applicants who complete the assessment and video will be considered. We look forward to your application!

**In this Compliance Product Enablement Student Assistant role, you’ll be…

**

• Translating legal documents and compliance-related content from English into Danish, ensuring legal precision, clarity, and consistency.

• Translating marketing materials containing compliance concepts to fit regional standards without losing accuracy.

• Supporting our software compliance work by helping maintain alignment with local laws, regulations, and industry standards.

• Assisting in the creation and maintenance of compliance blueprints alongside experienced market experts and our partners.

• Supported through a mentor-mentee relationship with a senior compliance specialist.

**Who is the Product Enablement Team?

**The Product Enablement Team sits at the intersection of our compliance domain expertise and market expansion. We ensure that our platform content, legal frameworks, and product materials are localised accurately across every market Formalize operates in.

We are part of Commercial, partnering closely with stakeholders in Product, Marketing, and Legal to bridge domain expertise with localised execution.

Essentially, we contribute to our vision by ensuring our software and messaging speak the language of local compliance with absolute precision.

**What you’ll bring:

**

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Communication, Business, or a related field.

• Native-level fluency in Danish with professional written and spoken English.

• Strong written communication skills with close attention to detail, tone, and legal nuance.

• A structured, proactive mindset with an interest in learning compliance frameworks and software localisation.

• Availability to work at least 15 hours per week at our Aarhus office.

**What do we offer you?

**

• An hourly salary ranging from 155 to 195 DKK.

• Our salary levels are directly linked to our structured career framework, which includes regular performance reviews, clear progression, and bi-annual growth talks.

• Dedicated guidance through a mentor–mentee relationship with a senior compliance expert.

• Thorough pre-boarding and onboarding to set you up for success.

• A culture of ownership, trust, and independence with the support you need.

• An office-first culture in a central location in Aarhus C (Frederiksgade 25), with benefits including lunch, health insurance, and social events.

• A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.

• Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company meets and connects.

****Our recruitment process

• Send your application and upload relevant information

• 15-30 minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition team

****About Formalize

****Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Madrid & Munich. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from 19 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We are celebrating our wins, learning from our mistakes, and growing together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation of our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy.

Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

****Ready to apply?

****We will hold interviews and hire on an ongoing basis. For more information or questions, please contact the responsible recruiter in the Talent Acquisition team. Apply now with your resume and other relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to seeing your application!

Make an impact with Laerdal!

Do you want to develop cutting-edge products that train healthcare professionals and ultimately help save lives? Join us at Laerdal Copenhagen, where we build world-class digital learning solutions used by millions globally.

The Team

We are building new capabilities for RQI (Resuscitation Quality Improvement) that help hospitals run CPR training the way their organisation actually works. That means connecting the training station to the learning systems hospitals already use, removing the friction between a learner walking up to the cart and starting a session, and giving the people who implement RQI the tools to configure it for their own context. You'll help shape these capabilities and weave them into one cohesive experience. In that way, your work will directly expand access to CPR training and support Laerdal's mission to help save more lives.

We work close to our customers: we visit hospitals, test our assumptions and build on modern technology, with an eye on where resuscitation training is heading next. You will work in a cross-functional product team in Laerdal Copenhagen with product management, design and engineering, as well as with other product teams across Copenhagen, Stavanger, and the US. The team owns the core platform capabilities and collaborates closely with partners across the wider RQI ecosystem.

The Role

We are looking for a React Frontend Engineer with experience building modern web and mobile applications. In this role, you will take ownership of the key user-facing flows of the platform.

You will,

• experiment, build and maintain web and mobile user interfaces using React and React Native

• collaborate closely with backend engineers on API design and data flows

• work closely with product managers and designers to translate user needs into intuitive frontend experiences

• contribute to the frontend architecture, patterns, and technical direction

• work in a "you build it, you run it" mindset with responsibility for production quality

Your Background

• Around 3+ years of professional software development experience

• Strong experience with React in production systems

• Hands-on experience with React Native and mobile development

• Understanding of frontend architecture, state management, and performance considerations

• Care deeply about usability, quality, and real user impact

• Enjoy close collaboration with designers and product managers

• Actively using AI-assisted development in your daily work

Our Tech Stack

• React (Web) & React Native (Mobile)

• C# / .NET Backend

• API‑driven integrations

• Cloud‑based infrastructure & modern CI/CD practices

Why Laerdal

Laerdal is a mission‑driven company working to help save one million more lives, every year, by 2030 (One Million Lives by Laerdal: A Shared Goal for 2030 - Laerdal - One Million Lives). You’ll be part of a collaborative, international environment with a strong focus on product quality, real‑world impact, and sustainable work–life balance.

We have a collaborative and diverse environment with lots of passion and energy. Our workplace is friendly and casual, located in an old warehouse close to Islands Brygge.

This is a full‑time role based at Laerdal's office in Copenhagen. We expect most workdays to be spent on‑site, with some flexibility for remote work during the week. You will report to the Engineering Manager and work closely with senior peers across engineering, product, and design.

Get a feeling of who we are in Laerdal Copenhagen in this video.

Reach Out

When you are ready to apply, please submit your CV and a short motivation letter. (remember that LinkedIn only allows one document, so just merge them into one):

• CV

• Motivation letter

If you have any questions that might keep you from applying, reach out to Lukas Zimmerli (Engineering Manager) at lukas.zimmerli@laerdal.com.

We’re looking for a Legal Engineer to join our Product team in Copenhagen. Someone with a strong legal foundation who is excited about AI, technology, and finding better ways to do legal work. You’ll get hands-on with our product, work on real legal problems, and help us build AI-powered tools that lawyers can actually rely on.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**As a Legal Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of law, AI, and product. You'll join our Product team and work closely with Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales.

This is a hands-on role: rather than practising law, you'll use your legal expertise to evaluate AI-generated legal work, figure out where and why it falls short, and turn real legal problems into scalable AI-powered workflows. It's a good fit if you like getting deep into legal detail but also enjoy stepping back to ask why something works and how it could work better.

**What You'll Do

**

• Evaluate and improve legal AI quality: test AI-generated legal research and analysis for correctness, completeness, reasoning, and source selection. Investigate where outputs fall short and turn findings into actionable input for Product and Engineering.

• Turn legal problems into AI-powered workflows: break down how lawyers actually perform a task, define what a good outcome looks like, and help develop, test, and refine workflows that solve it at scale.

• Bring UK legal expertise into product development: apply your knowledge of UK law, legal sources, and lawyer workflows to how we evaluate and build our products.

• Work on complex customer problems: partner with Customer Success and Sales on cases needing deeper legal expertise — understand the underlying problem, shape practical solutions, and feed what you learn back into Product.

• Help lawyers work effectively with AI: build workflows and examples that help customers get real value from AI in their legal work, and flag recurring needs that could inform future product decisions.

**What You’ll Bring

**We’re primarily looking for strong legal expertise and judgement. You don’t need a background in engineering, AI, or product development — those are things you can develop in the role.

• Advanced legal education or professional legal qualification, with a strong foundation in UK law gained through your education and/or professional training. You should be able to independently research, analyse, and assess UK complex and abstract legal questions.

• A couple of years of hands-on legal experience from a law firm, in-house legal team, public institution, or comparable legal environment.

• Strong experience with legal research and analysis, and the ability to work independently with complex legal questions and source material.

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to assess the quality of legal work, identify weaknesses or unsupported conclusions, and explain clearly what could be improved.

**Nice to have

**You don’t need to tick every box below. These are a plus, not requirements:

• Hands-on experience using AI tools for legal work, such as legal research, drafting, contract analysis, or document review.

• Familiarity with prompting, LLM evaluations, or systematically testing AI-generated outputs.

• Experience with document-heavy or structured legal workflows, such as due diligence, contract review, regulatory analysis, or multi-jurisdictional research.

• Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders and translating complex legal needs into practical solutions.

• Exposure to product development, user testing, or workflow design.

• Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or legal systems, particularly both common-law and civil-law systems.

• Basic technical or data literacy, such as structured data, APIs, advanced spreadsheets, or simple scripting.

• Additional language skills beyond English.

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in our Copenhagen HQ and remotely from Hamburg, Zurich and London. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + an attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses

• Paid parental leave

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

_

Do you want to lead one of the most exciting growth areas in the Nordic energy market?

As Head of Flexibility Solutions, you lead the strategic development, commercial growth, and operational excellence of Mind Energy’s flexibility business.

You’re leading a multidisciplinary domain being responsible for flexibility products, ancillary services, market participation, and the digital platform that enables it all. Working at the intersection of business, technology, operations, and energy markets, you will create scalable solutions that deliver measurable customer value while strengthening Mind Energy's position as a leading flexibility partner in the Nordics.

DIVE INTO WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY TASKS WILL BE

At Mind Energy, we organize around domains rather than traditional functional silos.

Each domain brings together commercial, operational, product, and technical capabilities around a shared business objective and customer outcome. This enables faster decision-making, stronger ownership, and closer collaboration across the value chain.

In this role you lead the Flexibility Domain and bring together commercial specialists, traders, product experts, developers, and operations professionals around a common mission: delivering market-leading flexibility solutions that create customer value and accelerate the energy transition.

Your mission is to:

• Define and lead the Flexibility Domain strategy, priorities, and roadmap, ensuring long-term business performance, growth, value creation, and market readiness.

• Drive the commercial development of flexibility solutions by translating customer needs, market developments, commercial opportunities, and regulatory changes into scalable products, services, business capabilities, and system initiatives.

• Co-own the roadmap and evolution of the Energy Trading Management Platform with the Product Owner, guiding investment and prioritization decisions across products, processes, and technology to deliver measurable business value.

• Ensure operational excellence across activation, monitoring, settlement, and performance management, while acting as the escalation point for critical commercial, operational, market, and system challenges and maintaining deep insight into Nordic balancing markets, ancillary services, and TSO requirements.

• Lead and develop a high-performing team built on ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement, turning market complexity into clear priorities, scalable solutions, and tangible results.

JOIN A TEAM OF MINDFUL ACHIEVERS

Working alongside commercial specialists, traders, developers, product experts, and operations professionals, you join a high-performing, cross-functional domain with end-to-end ownership of our flexibility business.

Combining deep market expertise with commercial, operational, and technical capabilities, the team has the mandate to make decisions that directly impact our products, customers, and business results. This setup enables close collaboration, rapid execution, and the ability to turn market complexity into scalable solutions that drive growth and support the energy transition.

LET’S SWITCH THE FOCUS TO YOU

You are a commercially minded leader who thrives in complex environments and enjoys turning market opportunities into scalable solutions.

You combine strategic thinking with operational execution and know how to create results through people, collaboration, and clear priorities.

We imagine you bring:

• Proven leadership experience with responsibility for people, business performance, and strategic execution, including building and developing high-performing teams

• Strong commercial acumen and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align commercial, operational, and technical interests to drive growth and value creation

• Experience balancing strategic priorities with operational execution and day-to-day delivery

• Relevant experience from the energy sector, preferably within flexibility, balancing markets, ancillary services, trading, or grid-related services

• Excellent communication skills, fluency in English, and a relevant degree or equivalent experience

• Knowledge of demand response, virtual power plants (VPPs), and balancing products such as mFRR, aFRR, and FCR is an advantage

• Proficiency in a Nordic language is an advantage

WE MIGHT BE BIASED, BUT IT IS QUITE AWESOME HERE

People here care about doing things well and creating a place people genuinely enjoy being part of. We like to hack the everyday, from breakfast and lunch made in-house with organic ingredients to in-house massage, something in the freezer when the day runs late and the occasional “Just Because” surprise. You also get five Switch Days, equal to a seventh holiday week, giving you extra flexibility and room to recharge throughout the year.

Through Mind Club, people come together around everything from padel and Football Shirt Fridays to clay pigeon shooting, movie premieres and our Christmas family day. And with Mind Academy, you grow alongside sharp and curious colleagues who challenge ideas, share knowledge and help each other level up. These are just some of the things that make us special. It’s easier to experience in person.

We’re mindful achievers. It shapes how we work, think and grow together, while recognizing that well-being, care and integrity matter just as much as the results we create. This is a place to focus, grow and achieve more.

LET US GET THIS CONVERSATION STARTED

If you want to join us – do not wait – send your resume and application as soon as you can, and no later than October 27, 2026.

Please send a short resume and application including:

• your motivation

• key examples of competences and experience

• your personal profile

If you have questions regarding the position, feel free to contact Vice President, Commercial Excellence, Sidse Mogensen by email at simo@mindenergy.com.

For general recruitment matters, contact people@mindenergy.com.

Can you bring together people, technology, and commercial ambition to accelerate the energy transition? Help us write the next chapter.

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Sensing Solutions, we develop advanced sensing technologies supporting applications across the Danfoss portfolio. Our work includes solutions for areas such as data centers, gas sensing, energy-efficient cooling, and environmental monitoring.

As our Development Engineer, you’ll help bring new sensing technologies and product concepts from idea to reality. Working alongside experienced engineers and technology specialists, you’ll contribute to developing products supporting our Data Center, Gas Sensing, and future technology programs.

You’ll have the opportunity to work across different areas of engineering, from mechanical design and prototyping to testing and integration with electronics and software. With a solid foundation in mechanical and electrical engineering and a curiosity to learn, you’ll build hands-on experience while contributing to meaningful product innovation from day one.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**You’ll work across a variety of development activities, gaining exposure to different engineering disciplines while helping bring new ideas and technologies to life.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Supporting the development of new sensing products and technology platforms from concept generation through prototype development and testing

• Creating CAD models, drawings, fixtures, mechanical components, and development tooling to support new product designs

• Building, assembling, and evaluating prototypes, while collecting and analyzing test data to support engineering decisions

• Collaborating with engineers across mechanical, electronics, software, and systems disciplines to mature new concepts and solve technical challenges

• Contributing to design verification, technical investigations, and engineering documentation

As your experience grows, you’ll have the opportunity to develop your skills across product development and explore different technical disciplines based on your strengths and interests.

**What We're Looking For

**You don’t need to have experience in every area of the role. What matters most is a strong mechanical foundation, a practical mindset, and the curiosity and motivation to keep learning.

To be successful in this role, we would expect you to have:

• A BSc or MSc degree in Mechatronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline

• A solid understanding of mechanical engineering fundamentals

• Experience using CAD tools for design and engineering documentation

• Practical, hands-on engineering experience gained through work, university projects, internships, or personal projects

• Curiosity, initiative, and an interest in developing your skills across different engineering disciplines

It Would Be An Advantage If You Have Gained Exposure To One Or More Of The Following Through Work, Studies, Projects, Or Personal Interests

• Product development

• Prototyping and testing

• Electronics and sensors

• Software development

**What You'll Get From Us

**You’ll join an environment where collaboration, learning, and continuous development are part of how we work, with the opportunity to broaden your experience as you grow in the role.

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

Icing on the cake  You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora   Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

**Position, purpose & impact

**As a Support Engineer in Global Tech Support, you will provide hands-on, customer-facing technical support that helps our customers operate Queue-it reliably during business-critical moments. Reporting to the Head of Global Tech Support, you'll join a global, collaborative support organization working across regions and cultures.

This role bridges customer needs with technically sound solutions - validating feasibility, answering technical questions, and guiding customers through supported implementation patterns. You'll troubleshoot incidents and product or integration issues with a calm, structured, and analytical approach, and contribute to proactive Event Support activities delivered together with Pre-sales & Solutions as part of Queue-it's professional services offering. This is a hands‑on role for someone who takes ownership and cares deeply about clear communication and reliable customer outcomes.

**Your toolkit

****Education

**

• Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Experience

**

• 1–3 years of experience in technical support, solutions engineering, web engineering, or a similar customer‑facing technical role.

**Skills

**

• Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Solid understanding of web fundamentals and delivery concepts, including HTTP, headers, cookies, caching, load balancing, and basic networking.

• Technical proficiency within the web communication knowledge domain and the ability to understand customer integrations.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks or customers in parallel in a structured way.

• Strong collaboration skills for working effectively with internal teams, including Product & Technology, Pre-sales & Solutions, and other GTM teams.

**Preferred

**

• Programming or scripting experience, such as JavaScript, .NET, Java, PHP, or Lua, mainly for troubleshooting and understanding customer integrations.

• Familiarity with CDN and edge delivery technologies such as Akamai, Cloudflare, or Amazon CloudFront.

• Experience with ecommerce platforms, ticketing platforms, or high‑traffic web environments.

• AWS, Azure, or similar technical certifications.

**The role in action

**

• Provide technical support for Queue-it customers as part of a 24/7 follow‑the‑sun support setup, including incident handling, alert response, and ticket resolution.

• Troubleshoot issues related to Queue-it configuration, product usage, supported integrations, and customer implementations.

• Support customers with integration‑related questions across common web technologies and supported deployment patterns.

• Diagnose technical issues related to traffic protection, waiting room behavior, connectors, and customer implementations.

• Participate in proactive monitoring and support during high‑traffic customer events, launches, and sales as part of Queue‑it's Event Support service.

• Communicate clearly with customers throughout incidents and support cases, ensuring timely follow‑up, accurate updates, and resolution within agreed SLAs.

• Collaborate with Product & Technology, Pre-sales & Solutions, and other Go‑To‑Market teams during escalations and complex investigations.

• Produce clear technical documentation and internal knowledge‑sharing material within the role's domain knowledge.

**Why join the Queue

**In this role, you will be working from our Vesterbro office in Copenhagen - Queue-it's largest office and global headquarters. The office is designed to support both collaboration and focus, with open workspaces, quiet rooms, and areas dedicated to deep work. You'll also find a ping pong table, foosball, and regular social activities that bring colleagues together.

At Queue-it, you're trusted to work in a way that suits you best, supported by a strength-based approach and a flat hierarchy inspired by Danish work culture. You'll be part of a global, collaborative environment with colleagues from 40+ nationalities, where diverse perspectives are valued and teamwork across cultures is the norm. We prioritize professional growth, open dialogue, and creating a strong sense of community. Daily snacks, fresh fruit, great coffee, and access to a subsidized canteen in the building are all part of the experience.

**What We're About

**At Queue-it, we help some of the world's biggest brands like Ticketmaster, Sky Mobile, Hermes and Peach Aviation navigate their busiest days with confidence. Our virtual waiting room technology keeps websites running smoothly during high-traffic events – creating fairer and more reliable online experiences for billions of users.

But we're more than just software. We're a global team representing 40+ nationalities across Denmark, the U.S., South Korea, Australia, and Japan. We believe in the power of trust – not only in the digital experiences we protect, but in the culture we build together.

We take a strength-based approach to work, encouraging people to do what they do best and supporting them to thrive. You'll join a supportive, collaborative environment that values individuality, learning, and connection. And yes – we like to have fun too. From regular social events and celebrations to cultural and learning initiatives, we make time to connect and enjoy the Queue.

We are empowered by trust and strengthened by people.

atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, and Sweden.

We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

Are you an experienced project manager with a passion for delivering complex security solutions in mission-critical environments? As a Security Delivery Project Manager at atNorth, you will play a key role in ensuring the successful delivery of physical security systems and infrastructure across our growing portfolio of data center projects throughout the Nordics.

Working closely with Security, Design, Delivery, Construction, IT, Operations, Customer Implementation teams, and external partners, you will ensure that security requirements are embedded from concept through to commissioning and handover. You will be responsible for driving project execution, managing stakeholders, mitigating risks, and ensuring all security deliverables meet atNorth standards, customer requirements, and project timelines.

As a trusted delivery partner, you will coordinate consultants, contractors, vendors, and system integrators to ensure security solutions are delivered safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities

****Project Delivery & Execution

**

• Lead the delivery of physical security solutions across new data center builds, expansions, and upgrade projects.

• Manage project plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication to ensure successful delivery.

• Ensure security requirements are embedded into project designs and aligned with customer, operational, and business requirements.

• Coordinate closely with internal teams, consultants, contractors, vendors, and system integrators throughout the project lifecycle.

• Oversee installation activities, quality assurance processes, and issue resolution to ensure compliance with approved standards and designs.

**Commissioning, Handover & Stakeholder Management

**

• Coordinate testing, commissioning, system validation, and acceptance activities for physical security systems.

• Ensure all documentation, training records, as-built drawings, and handover packages are completed and maintained.

• Support operational readiness by ensuring a smooth transition of security systems to operational teams and site stakeholders.

• Monitor project risks, design gaps, quality concerns, and change requests, driving timely resolution and escalation when required.

• Provide regular reporting, progress updates, and decision support to project stakeholders and leadership teams.

**Your Profile

**

• 7+ years of experience managing security, construction, infrastructure, or technology projects in complex environments.

• Strong experience delivering physical security systems, including access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, alarm monitoring, and related infrastructure.

• Proven project management expertise in planning, scheduling, dependency management, risk management, quality assurance, and stakeholder engagement.

• Experience working with consultants, EPCM organizations, contractors, system integrators, and specialist security vendors.

• Strong understanding of security design reviews, commissioning processes, operational readiness, and project governance.

• Experience within data centers, critical infrastructure, industrial facilities, construction, or other high-availability environments is highly desirable.

• Professional certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-SP, PSP, CPP, or equivalent are considered an advantage.

• Fluency in English is required. One or more Nordic languages is considered an advantage.

**About The AtNorth Culture

**We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together. #99

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Consultant - Fund Administration & Accounting
jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values : caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As a Senior Business Consultant in Consulting, you will support our clients with best-practice market solutions and with services related to the use of SimCorp Dimension and beyond. You will work closely with local and global SimCorp teams, serving clients in their post-implementation phases. Drawing on your coordination skills and SimCorp Dimension expertise, you will collaborate with client and internal stakeholders on investment solutions, incident and problem management, and small changes or enhancements to current or future flows, all aimed at raising the level of automation and the end-user experience and satisfaction. Because the role is functional, Fund Administration & Accounting expertise is required. As part of your induction, you will work hands-on with our software and attend the three-week SimCorp Dimension® Academy, so you have steady support as you grow into the role.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Contribute to all aspects of SimCorp Dimension implementation projects.

• Advise on process improvements through better use of SimCorp Dimension, and help improve and document best practices for implementations.

• Map client needs to SimCorp Dimension functions and processes, and design and configure the setup.

• Lead the delivery of customised solutions with focus on Fund administration and Accounting.

• Assist clients in developing an overall test strategy and test plans, and support them in executing those plans.

• Drive the preparation and execution of test cases.

• Facilitate workshops to gather requirements for new and existing clients.

• Mentor, coach and enable colleagues to secure reliable project deliveries.

**What We Value

**

• Motivation to contribute and thrive in the position described above, which matters most.

• Proven skills in the areas below, however you gained them, as the route matters less than the capability.

• Investment accounting knowledge, some familiarity with any local GAAPS, IFRS9 would be an advantage

• Fund administration knowledge, including NAV calculation, Fund Structure and NAV Validation

• A strong background in effective consulting and project management.

• Demonstrated experience in software implementation projects.

• Enthusiasm for learning and using new software.

• A desire to act as a mentor and coach to less experienced colleagues.

• Good English, our corporate language, which is used in all communications.

• Knowledge of another European language is also appreciated. Danish is also an advantage

**Benefits

**SimCorp provides a range of benefits that may influence decisions regarding job offers. With operations in more than 30 offices globally, the benefits package can differ depending on the country. SimCorp implements a global hybrid work policy, requiring employees to be in the office two days per week and permitting remote work on other days. Additional information about location-specific benefits is available from the recruiter.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Launchpad user our Lead Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp and you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above, but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway.

SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Are you a people leader with a strong programme and project management background? Do you excel at creating momentum, leading experienced project managers, and delivering complex transformation initiatives in a high-stakes environment?

As Senior Manager, Athene Programme, you will join the leadership team of the Athene Programme and take ownership of a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives across Supply Chain Management and Data Platform. You will lead a team of experienced project managers and play a key role in ensuring that projects are delivered successfully, while building a strong delivery culture and developing the people behind the delivery.

You will be expected to challenge stakeholders, create clarity in complexity, make decisions, remove obstacles, and help the organisation move forward. Success requires both strong leadership and strong execution capabilities.

What success will look like?

As Senior Manager, Athene Programme, you will be responsible for delivering business-critical transformation initiatives through others. Success is measured not only by project outcomes, but by your ability to build a high-performing team, create alignment across stakeholders, and drive execution in a complex international environment.

**During your first 6 months, we expect you to:

**

• Establish ownership of your project portfolio across the Supply Chain Management and Data Platform value streams.

• Build strong relationships with project managers, business leaders, IT stakeholders, and programme leadership.

• Create clarity around priorities, governance, delivery plans, risks, and dependencies.

• Put effective leadership and follow-up routines in place for the project managers reporting to you.

• Become a trusted sparring partner to the Programme Director and wider leadership team.

**Within your first year, you will have:

**

• Delivered key programme commitments according to agreed timelines and objectives.

• Built a motivated and high-performing team of project managers with clear accountability and ownership.

• Strengthened collaboration across Business Transformation, IT, and the business organisation.

• Established a strong delivery culture focused on transparency, execution, and shared accountability.

• Successfully supported major programme implementations and business readiness activities.

**In the longer term, you will:

**

• Build a project management capability that continues to create value beyond the Athene programme.

• Create an environment where talented project managers grow, develop, and choose to stay.

• Help strengthen STARK Group's overall transformation and delivery capabilities.

• Be recognised as a leader who turns complexity into tangible business results while bringing people along on the journey.

The role includes approximately 30-50 travel days annually across the Nordics.

Team, Reporting Line & Collaboration

You will report to Tommas Bjørnbak Tygesen, Programme Director and Vice President, and become part of the Athene Programme Leadership Team.

You will have direct people management responsibility for a team of experienced project managers, both internal and external, working across the Data Platform and Supply Chain Management value streams. Together, they are responsible for delivering some of the most important components of the Athene programme.

In your daily work, you will collaborate closely with Business Transformation, PMO, IT Delivery, value stream leads, business owners, and senior stakeholders across the Nordic organisation.

The role can be based either in Viby J (Aarhus) or Frederiksberg (Copenhagen). Regardless of your primary workplace, you should expect to travel to the other location approximately 1-2 times per month, typically for 2-3 days at a time, as your team and key stakeholders are based across both offices.

Who are we looking for?

You have likely built your career within project and programme management and are now motivated by leading people and creating results through others.

You know how to create structure without creating bureaucracy. You are comfortable making decisions, handling competing priorities, and maintaining momentum when things become complex. At the same time, you are a leader who builds trust. You challenge constructively, communicate clearly, and create accountability without creating fear. You are calm under pressure, pragmatic in your approach, and able to bring people together around a common goal.

It will be an advantage if you have experience with:

• Leading large-scale transformation programmes, ERP implementations, or business-critical change initiatives.

• Managing a portfolio of projects in an international matrix organisation.

• People leadership and development of project managers or similar delivery roles.

• Working across both business and IT environments.

• Programme governance, risk management, planning, and financial follow-up.

• Motivated by engaging with stakeholders in a value-driven and decentralised organisation

• Agile, waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches.

• Relevant certifications such as PRINCE2, PMP, MSP, PgMP, SAFe, or similar.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who combines strong leadership with strong execution. Someone who can create clarity when complexity increases, make decisions when needed, and build a team that succeeds together.

Welcome to the Athene Programme

Athene is one of STARK Group's largest transformation programmes and plays a central role in building the future technology and business platform for the entire group.

You will join a leadership team characterised by trust, openness, and a strong sense of shared responsibility. Decisions are often made through collaboration, relationships, and influence rather than hierarchy, making this an exciting opportunity for leaders who thrive in decentralised environments.

The pace is high, ambitions are significant, and change is constant. At the same time, you will join a team that genuinely supports one another and believes that long-term success is created together.

Want to know more and apply?

We are happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the position and your opportunities at STARK Group. For questions regarding the role, please contact Tommas Bjørnbak Tygesen, Programme Director and Vice President, at tommas.tygesen@stark.dk

We are looking for someone to join as soon as possible and will conduct interviews on an ongoing basis until the right candidate has been found.

STARK Group

STARK Group is a growing private equity-owned company with a strong legacy. STARK Group was first established in Denmark in 1896 and has today evolved into a leading European retailer and distributor of heavy building materials with net sales of approx. EUR 9 billion. With a dedicated team of more than 20,000 employees and +1,150 branches and distribution centres across the Nordics, Greenland, Germany, Austria and the UK, we live and breathe to serve professional craftsmen with heavy building materials all the way from the Austrian Alps to Tromsø, close to the Arctic circle and everywhere in between.

STARK Group is committed to reach net zero emissions by 2050 across the entire business, is a signatory to the UN Global Compact, and works within fully 2030 validated science-based targets to keep global warming below 1.5°C At STARK Group IT, we believe in the richness diversity brings. We invite individuals of all backgrounds to join us in creating and inclusive and welcoming environment. We believe in a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work.

**Agency Policy

**STARK Group IT appreciates the interest of all candidates. However, we prefer to directly engage with individuals seeking employment opportunities. Therefore, we kindly request recruitment agencies, headhunters, and third-party staffing services to refrain from contacting us regarding this job posting. All applications should be submitted directly by the candidates through our official application process. We value direct communication and look forward to reviewing your application.

About us:

Founded in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2014, Templafy’s success is built by our 60+ employee nationalities found at offices around the world. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and empowered, they perform at their best—creating a win for all. Our unique product and dedication to innovation and excellence have raised over $200 million in funding from top investors like Insight Venture Partners, Seed Capital, Dawn Capital, Damgaard Company and Golub Capital.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on, resourceful Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Technical Operations team.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Templafy, you will play a critical role in supporting our growth by working directly with strategic customers to design, build, and deploy tailored solutions that bring Templafy’s platform into their real-world environments.

You will take deep technical ownership of the customer journey—from initial discovery and solution design through implementation and launch. You’ll work closely with customers to understand their most complex document workflows and build the environments, integrations, and AI-powered solutions needed to solve them.

This is a highly collaborative and customer-facing role that sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and commercial strategy.

What You’ll Do

Embedded Customer Engineering

Work on-site or virtually alongside strategic customers to build, configure, and integrate Templafy solutions directly into their document workflows.

Custom Solution Development

Design and build tailored customer environments using their content, business rules, integrations, knowledge, and data to address complex document use cases and deliver solutions that meet their specific needs.

Technical Discovery & Architecture Mapping

Partner with Solutions Consulting and Professional Services to understand complex customer requirements and translate them into concrete technical architectures and implementation plans.

Rapid Prototyping

Build proof-of-concept integrations, document agents, and workflow automations to quickly validate solution fit before moving into full implementation.

Product Collaboration

Work closely with Product Managers to share insights and feedback from real-world customer use cases, helping shape the product and ensure our document agents continue to meet evolving customer needs.

Deployment & Change Management

Support customer rollout, training, and adoption of custom-built solutions, ensuring a smooth transition to the customer’s internal teams and Templafy’s Customer Success organization.

Accelerate Packaging & Repeatability

Use insights gained from customer implementations to partner with our Pricing and Packaging team to identify common use cases and help develop repeatable solutions across industries and business functions.

What We’re Looking For

• Academic background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, another technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years of experience as a Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, or similar technical customer-facing role, ideally within enterprise SaaS or applied AI.

• Strong commercial and technical discovery skills, with the ability to translate business needs and technical requirements into working solutions.

• Ability to identify gaps during discovery and proactively engage the appropriate customer stakeholders to gather the information needed to move forward.

• Experience working with REST APIs, enterprise integrations, authentication/SSO, and automation frameworks.

• Strong technical curiosity and interest in AI. Experience integrating with or building on top of LLM providers such as OpenAI or Anthropic is a strong plus.

• Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and turning loosely defined customer problems into working software.

• Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts, recommendations, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Understanding of enterprise document governance and workflows, with the confidence to engage directly with senior and C-level IT stakeholders.

• Strong technical and user-facing knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word and PowerPoint, and their file structures is a plus.

• Willingness and ability to travel and spend time on-site with customers as needed.

• A strong bias toward action, ownership, and problem-solving in a fast-moving and innovative environment.

How We’ll Measure Success

Success in this role will include:

• Identifying complex business document scenarios and developing solutions that are successfully implemented in customers’ production environments.

• Enabling customers to successfully launch custom document agents and solutions.

• Supporting strong win rates for Custom Document Agent opportunities.

• Driving repeat end-user adoption of Custom Document Agents.

• Turning customer-specific learnings into insights that can improve Templafy’s product and create repeatable solutions for future customers.

Employee Benefits:

• Employee equity program

• Private health insurance

• Company lunch contribution

• Phone and broadband covered by company

• Centrally located office – easy access to public transportation

• Company events and team activities

• Flexible work environment

• Gympass Subscription

• Calm App Subscription

At Templafy, we’re all about building an inclusive culture where talented people come together to spark creativity in a dynamic, collaborative space. Strong relationships and teamwork are at the core of everything we do, and with our flat structure, everyone’s ideas count regardless of your role or experience.

We’re big on social events that foster connection and build a diverse, empowering community. From celebrating milestones to participating in employee resource groups or eating lunch together, we create space for meaningful team bonding.

Our mission goes beyond just building a product; we’re shaping the future, and we’d love for you to be a part of this epic journey with us.

Templafy is a workplace of belongingness. To us this means that you have a voice, you dare to speak up, and your voice is heard. We focus on offering an environment that allows all employees to feel that they belong regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, genetic information, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or other status.
